name: Yumo-nano
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from agentica-org/DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from agentica-org/DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview: 28 full GQA layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-03. A finetune of agentica-org/DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.777 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-06. CAVEAT: the base-column scores are quoted from DeepScaleR-1.5B's own card, not re-run by the author, so this is a single-run comparison against a published number. Two of the five gains are noise-level (MATH 500 87.9 vs 87.8, AIME 2024 43.5 vs 43.1); the defensible gains are OlympiadBench +2.9 and Minerva Math +2.1. The card's 'Avg 60.3' is not the mean of its own five rows (58.2); the five rows, not the Avg, are what this record carries. No harness, shot count or pass@k is printed anywhere on the card. The fine-tune is a three-phase SFT curriculum on one RTX 4080 with no RL stage.
